shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git branch --show-current
git status --short
sed -n '1,220p' specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts
sed -n '1,180p' .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"spec-names|validated by|specs/hal-engine\" package.json scripts .github .re-lint* 2>/dev/null | head -100"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n \"require-spec-link|validated by\" . --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' | head -160
find scripts -maxdepth 3 -type f -name '*spec*' -o -name '*reanchor*'
git log -3 --oneline --stat
git show --stat --oneline HEAD
nl -ba src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts | sed -n '45,75p'
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md | sed -n '12,30p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node -e \"const p=require('./package.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(p.scripts,null,2))\"
npx prettier --write specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md
node scripts/check-spec-anchor-names.mjs specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git diff --check
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md .lore/dod.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md
git commit -m "fix dynamic schema test traceability"
git push origin HEAD'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main
git merge --no-edit origin/main
if [ "$(git rev-list --count '"'@{upstream}..HEAD')\" -gt 0 ]; then git push origin HEAD; fi
git status --short --branch"
